_meta.purpose: Independent nearest-below (arbitrary-PC) oracle for SPEC-address-resolver.md §5.7. Additive to resolver.golden.json (which only covers exact aliased addresses). Expected values computed by Fable's independent §5.7 implementation (explore_near.cjs) and hand-verified against Nova source + the raw #LINES table, NOT derived from resolver.cjs.
_meta.sourceCompare: by basename + line (full-path plumbing is covered by resolver.golden.json)
_meta.notes: base is a 4-hex-digit string; offset is a number; name/source null means the plausibility gate rejected that facet.

cases.name: exact-line-no-symbol (the common return-address case, finding #1a)
cases.why: PC has an EXACT #LINES entry (c0ef -> memory.s:23 'lda _MemsetValue') but NO symbol at c0ef. Source must use that exact line; name = nearest symbol below (_MemsetSimple@c0ed).

cases.name: mid-routine, no exact line (floor line below, finding #1b)
cases.why: PC c002 has no line entry (table has c001->116, c003->117); floor line = c001 (kernel.s:116 'lda #0', code). Nearest symbol below = _KernelEntry@c000.

cases.name: interior of a data block (PC inside a .word vector)
cases.why: PC fffb is the 2nd byte of _VectorNMI's .word at fffa. No line at fffb; floor line = fffa (loader.asm:542 '.word IrqDoNothing' -> data). Name = _VectorNMI@fffa, offset 1, kind data.

cases.name: ZP / low-page cross-page gate (no mid-memory owner)
cases.why: PC 0200 (page 2). Nearest symbol below is a ZP symbol on page 0; plausible() requires same page for base<0x400 -> rejected. Nearest line below is also a ZP line -> rejected. Both facets null.

cases.name: unlabeled stretch beyond NEAR_SPAN
cases.why: PC e23d sits 1100 bytes above the nearest symbol/line below (ddf1), which exceeds NEAR_SPAN=1024. Gate rejects both -> no func+$big lie. Empty record.

cases.name: overlay view mid-routine (module 0), source-text code
cases.why: setActiveModule(0). PC 2d50 = _DrawClock+2; exact line 2d50 -> module_megabuilding.s:1186 'sta _frame_idx' (code by source text). module field must be the OWNER's module (0).

cases.name: overlay view mid-routine (module 0), second case
cases.why: PC 289f = _FlashLoop+2; exact line 289f -> module_megabuilding.s:438 'sta _delay_idx' (code). _FlashLoop's #SYM decl line (119) differs from the code line (438) — source is the enclosing code line, not the decl line.
